load_json_paco_annotations: load a PACO LVIS-format JSON annotation file and return Detectron2 standard dataset records
register_all_paco_datasets: register all PACO LVIS and EGO4D datasets with Detectron2 DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog
register_all_golden_paco_datasets: register ImageNet golden PACO datasets with Detectron2 using COCO instance format
get_instances_meta_paco: get PACO instance metadata including thing classes, part classes, attribute classes, and image counts
register_single_paco_instance: register a single PACO dataset instance with name, metadata, JSON file path, and image root directory
